query: What are the procedures for reporting malfunctioning traffic signals in Tamil Nadu urban areas?
reference_answer:
Reporting Traffic Signal Malfunctions:
To report traffic signal malfunctions in Tamil Nadu cities, call the police control room (100) or contact the local traffic police station. You can also use the Tamil Nadu Police Department's mobile app or website to report the issue.
answer: In Tamil Nadu's urban areas, to report malfunctioning traffic signals, one should contact the local traffic police or the municipal corporation office. They can provide the correct procedure and details on how to report the issue. [Document 1]
